aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:867.title: Fall Intern, Accounting – Goldenvoice Venues
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:867.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary: AEG Internship Program offers a real-world experience that allows college students to learn the business of sports and live entertainment. The intern will have the opportunity to see how Goldenvoice operates behind the scenes while supporting the accounting team in various account reconciliations and variance analysis for its venues. Responsibilities: Enter artist settlement documents and support account reconciliations Process Accounts Payable submissions and generate reports (e.g., Hubble exports) Assist with special event settlements and month‑end data entry Assist with ticket reconciliations Perform administrative tasks Qualifications: Passion for live entertainment Currently pursuing a degree in a relevant field such as Accounting/Finance, Business Administration, Data Analysis, etc. Experience with Microsoft Office (Excel) and Smartsheet preferred Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and communication skills Strong communication and time management skills Ability to multi-task and work well under pressure Desire to learn more about the entertainment industry The AEG Internship Program requires a minimum commitment of 18 hours per week during the fall. Benefits: Work on increasingly challenging and engaging real-world projects Work closely with experienced team members who coach and provide mentorship Attend meetings, events, and other networking opportunities Intern Perks Corporate networking Resume review with the AEG Talent Acquisition team Pay Scale: $19.00 - $21.00 Location: Los Angeles (On-Site) Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Part-time: This position is not eligible for benefits. AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description, whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside his/her normal description. AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants, and we comply with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws in making hiring and employee decisions. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, marital status, disability, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status recognized by applicable federal, state or local law. Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:9c50d9c.title: Partnerships
axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:9c50d9c.description: ABOUT US At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here https://www.axle.energy/blog/analysis/power-of-the-home. ABOUT THE ROLE Our Partnerships role requires someone who can accelerate the deployment of our products, help clients roll out flexibility across their customer base, and adapt processes pragmatically without getting stuck in bureaucracy. Axle's success is intertwined with that of our partners'; by helping our partners onboard & scale, you'll be the conduit to Axle's B2B2C growth. We're looking for someone with strong commercial instincts to drive exceptional results with our partners. This is a multifaceted, client-facing role with a strong technical component. THIS ROLE WILL OWN - Partner relationship management - Onboarding and implementation - Account growth and expansion WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING - Owning client relationships from onboarding to account expansion, ensuring partners unlock full value from our products by aligning our tech with their evolving needs - Providing go-to-market insights on user propositions, communication strategies, and market positioning - Managing post-implementation relationships with clients after go-live, drive continuous improvement and opportunity to deepen engagement or grow the account - Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements - Creating scalable processes (and design scalable products) across diverse customer segments - Making data-driven decisions & improvements, internally and externally WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity). We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. INTERVIEW PROCESS 1. Initial interview 2. Take-home exercise 3. Final interview (in-person) 4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

cagents-cagents:lever:3ae1170e-2a91-404f.title: Building Commissioning Project Manager
cagents-cagents:lever:3ae1170e-2a91-404f.description: Are You Ready? CAI is a professional services company established in 1996 that has grown year over year to nearly 800 people worldwide. For Life Sciences and Mission Critical industries that need to deliver critical solutions in high-stakes environments, we provide accelerated operational readiness and unparalleled performance at the highest standard through our rigorous approach, field-tested processes, and elite expertise developed over 30 years. Our approach is simple because our Purpose informs everything we do: We exist to be the trusted solution for our clients as they strive to build a better working world and improve the human experience. At CAI, we are committed to living our Foundational Principles, both professionally and personally: - We act with integrity - We serve each other - We serve society - We work for our future At CAI, we believe in a relentless dedication to excellence, pushing boundaries and surpassing expectations. From the beginning, we’ve challenged ourselves to do what others wouldn’t. Not just setting industry standards, but redefining them entirely. We are bold in our thinking and creative in our approach. We operate at the intersection of wisdom and technology and thrive when they come together with humanity. For us, operational readiness isn’t simply a goal. It’s a way of life. Because tomorrow demands to be at the forefront of today. We do this through tireless effort, precision, efficiency and an unwavering belief that there is always room for advancement. We’re not interested in how it used to be done. We’re obsessed with how it will be done. We are seeking a highly skilled, organized, and proactive Commissioning Project Manager to join our team. As a Commissioning Project Manager, you will play a critical role in overseeing and driving the commissioning process for capital construction and operational readiness & excellence projects from design through post occupancy. This is an exciting opportunity to lead diverse, complex projects across life sciences, semiconductors, battery manufacturing, and other mission-critical industries, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations. Key Responsibilities - Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of the commissioning process for capital projects, ensuring alignment with scope, schedule, and budget requirements. - Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, resource allocations, risk assessments, and communication strategies. - Coordinate and manage the commissioning team, as well as lead coordination with project stakeholders including engineers, construction managers, design engineers, technicians, and clients. - Monitor project performance, proactively identifying risks, troubleshooting issues, and implementing solutions to ensure a successful commissioning process. - Track and report on project deliverables, milestones, and financial performance to leadership and clients. - Ensure compliance with quality standards, design, safety regulations, and company best practices. - Facilitate project meetings, ensuring effective communication and collaboration across cross-functional teams. - Serve as a key liaison between the client and internal teams, maintaining strong relationships and driving customer satisfaction. Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Facilities/Mechanical/Electrical engineering or related field. - 5-10 years of experience executing and leading the commissioning process. - Proven experience as a Project Manager for commissioning projects within capital construction, life sciences, semiconductors, or other mission-critical industries. - Strong knowledge and proven experience both leading and executing the commissioning process. - Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, processes, and tools. - Proficiency in creating and managing project schedules, budgets, and documentation. - Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and org

jobgether-jobgether:lever:49e56715-eb40-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Business Transformation & Operations based in France. This is a senior, high-ownership leadership role combining business transformation, operational excellence, client advisory, and commercial growth. You will diagnose complex organizational challenges across people, processes, technology, and management systems. The role goes beyond strategy, requiring you to turn recommendations into structured plans, implementation, training, and measurable outcomes. You will work directly with clients to understand their needs and shape engagements that address their most important business challenges. You will also contribute to proposals, presentations, business development, and closing new opportunities. Strong judgment and the confidence to constructively challenge senior leadership will be essential to driving meaningful change. This opportunity is particularly suited to an experienced transformation leader who wants broad ownership and the potential to grow into a General Manager-level role. Diagnose organizational performance and operating models across people, processes, technology, workflows, and management systems to identify root causes and improvement opportunities. Design and redesign organizational structures, workflows, processes, accountability models, and management systems to improve effectiveness and scalability. Translate strategic direction into actionable transformation plans with clearly defined owners, milestones, dependencies, priorities, and measurable evidence of results. Lead implementation initiatives from planning through execution and adoption, ensuring recommendations are effectively embedded into day-to-day operations. Coordinate training, change management, and stakeholder adoption activities, and verify that implemented solutions deliver the intended outcomes. Lead client discovery sessions to understand business challenges, objectives, operational realities, and desired outcomes. Translate client requirements into appropriate transformation strategies, service engagements, and practical solutions. Contribute to proposals, presentations, commercial discussions, and new-business development activities. Support the sales process by identifying opportunities, shaping solutions, communicating value, and helping move prospective engagements toward closure. Build strong relationships with clients and senior stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor throughout transformation initiatives. Constructively challenge executives and senior leaders when data, evidence, or operational realities indicate that a different approach is required. Apply AI, automation, and technology-enabled workflows to improve organizational efficiency, decision-making, and service delivery. Coordinate cross-functional teams and maintain alignment across transformation priorities, implementation activities, and business objectives. Requirements Significant leadership experience in organizational effectiveness, business transformation, management consulting, operational strategy, general management, or a closely related discipline. Demonstrated track record of taking transformation initiatives from diagnosis and strategy through implementation, adoption, and measurable results. Strong experience analyzing organizations holistically across people, processes, technology, structure, and operating models. Proven client-facing experience with the ability to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with senior executives. Demonstrated sales, business development, consulting, or commercial experience, including contributing to proposals and closing new engagements. Advanced, practical experience using AI, automation, and technology-enabled workflows to improve business processes and outcomes. Our partner is looking for a Digital Marketing Assistant based in India. This role is ideal for a versatile digital marketing professional who enjoys working across multiple channels and projects in a fast-paced remote environment. You will support a broad range of marketing activities, from content creation and social media management to email campaigns, paid advertising, analytics, and web updates. The position offers variety and requires strong organization, creativity, and the ability to manage competing priorities independently. You’ll work closely with client needs and deadlines, helping strengthen digital presence and improve audience engagement and conversions. The role also provides opportunities to contribute to marketing processes, best practices, and campaign optimization. It is well suited to a proactive professional who is comfortable learning new tools and adapting to different digital platforms. Create and manage written and visual digital marketing content across relevant channels. Schedule and publish content across platforms including Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other social networks. Prepare communications and presentations for clients and stakeholders. Create and document repeatable marketing processes to improve efficiency and consistency. Manage multiple assignments while meeting client expectations and agreed deadlines. Excellent written and spoken English with strong professional communication skills. Demonstrated experience with social media management, content creation, scheduling, and performance metrics. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and confidence working with common digital productivity tools. Familiarity with current technologies such as cloud services, desktop-sharing tools, and VoIP platforms. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a733ab27-3a1f-.title: Total Rewards Strategy and Portfolio Acceleration Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a733ab27-3a1f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Total Rewards Strategy and Portfolio Acceleration Lead based in the United States. This senior role will shape and accelerate an enterprise-wide Total Rewards strategy across a complex, global organization. You will connect functional reward strategies into a unified portfolio, strengthening governance, planning, execution, and operational excellence. The position combines strategic planning, portfolio leadership, change management, communications, and AI-enabled transformation. You will work closely with senior HR leaders, Finance, Legal, Communications, and other business partners to align priorities and drive measurable outcomes. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between long-term strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-changing environment. You will influence major decisions, improve ways of working, and help embed stronger planning and delivery disciplines across the function. The position may also involve leading a small team and serving as a trusted strategic partner to senior Total Rewards leadership. Portfolio leadership: Manage the Total Rewards portfolio, leadership-team meetings, and broader function forums to prioritize and accelerate the highest-impact initiatives. Strategic planning: Develop and support short- and long-term Total Rewards strategies, operating plans, priorities, and execution roadmaps aligned with enterprise objectives. AI transformation: Lead AI-enabled transformation across Total Rewards, partnering with relevant teams to embed AI into processes, decision-making, and everyday ways of working. Leadership support: Serve as a central coordination point for senior Total Rewards leadership, supporting strategy, planning, execution, and key decision-making forums. Business planning: Coordinate operating reviews, budget planning, and other planning processes while ensuring Total Rewards priorities remain aligned with enterprise timelines and objectives. Executive partnership: Act as a trusted proxy for senior leadership when requested, representing priorities and facilitating alignment in key meetings and decision forums. Cross-functional alignment: Partner with HR, Finance, Legal, Communications, centers of expertise, business planners, and field HR teams to coordinate initiatives and integrate Total Rewards planning with broader organizational priorities. Executive communications: Develop presentations, leadership materials, strategic updates, and communications that clearly articulate Total Rewards priorities, strategies, progress, and outcomes. Process improvement: Identify and implement improvements to functional business-management processes, increasing consistency, efficiency, speed, and quality across the Total Rewards organization. OKRs and performance management: Support the development of annual OKRs, facilitate planning discussions, and monitor progress against strategic objectives throughout the year. Change and culture: Support talent development, capability building, employee engagement, organizational culture, and change readiness across the Total Rewards function. Agility and special projects: Quickly take ownership of emerging priorities, organize and coordinate new work, and lead special projects as business needs evolve. Portfolio optimization: Conduct research, assess market trends, identify opportunities for investment or divestment, and evaluate potential future partners or capabilities. Financial management: Support Total Rewards P&L and budget management while maintaining strong focus on resource allocation and portfolio value. Team leadership: Where applicable, lead and develop a small team supporting the function’s strategic planning, portfolio management, and execution priorities. Requirements: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required; a master’s degree is preferred.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c77f7b38-a921-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QE Engineer based in Canada. This role is focused on building quality into the software development lifecycle through structured testing and quality engineering practices. You will work closely with development and product teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test strategies. The position combines test planning, automation, continuous testing, and validation across large-scale distributed software environments. You will contribute throughout the full project lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, execution, and evaluation. The role offers the opportunity to work with modern engineering practices including Agile, DevOps, BDD, and automated testing frameworks. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams while taking ownership of quality engineering activities with minimal supervision. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced QA professional who enjoys solving complex testing challenges and improving software reliability. Participate in requirements gathering and software design phases to develop a thorough understanding of business requirements and ensure testing strategies address business needs. Design comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and quality engineering approaches aligned with project requirements. Implement established quality engineering processes throughout the software development lifecycle, including planning, design, implementation, execution, and evaluation. Develop and execute automated and manual testing activities across large-scale, distributed software environments. Apply behavior-driven development and automation practices to improve test coverage, repeatability, and software quality. Collaborate with developers, product teams, and other stakeholders to identify potential quality risks and ensure requirements are effectively validated. Support continuous testing and DevOps practices by integrating quality activities into development and deployment workflows. Perform database and data validation testing where required, ensuring application behavior and underlying data meet expected requirements. Use relevant testing, development, and product management tools to document, track, and communicate testing activities and results. Contribute to model-based testing and other structured quality engineering methodologies. Work independently on assigned quality engineering activities while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, automation coverage, and overall software quality. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in enterprise software testing, preferably within large-scale distributed software environments. Hands-on experience with technologies and frameworks such as Gherkin, REST Assured, Java, and Apache POI. At least 2 years of experience working with Agile methodologies, tools, and quality engineering practices. Experience with GitHub, DevOps, Jenkins, Playwright, BDD automation, database testing, continuous testing, and model-based testing. Familiarity with product and application lifecycle management tools such as RTC, RQM, Jira, Client ALM, or Rally. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and quality engineering processes across the full development lifecycle. Ability to design effective test plans and scenarios based on business and technical requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify defects, quality risks, and potential gaps in requirements. Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability for assigned deliverables. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a cross-functional engineering team. Experience with ETL testing is an advantage. southparkcommons-doppel:ashbyhq:45616a52.description: Why Join Doppel Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. What We're Building We're building the AI-native social engineering defense platform. This means we're designing scalable systems that monitor billions of domains, social media accounts, apps, dark web forums, etc., and leverage AI agents to identify and neutralize digital threats. (Multiple Positions & Various Levels/Types) Job duties: - Build the AI-native social engineering defense platform. - Design scalable systems that monitor billions of domains, social media accounts, apps, dark web foreums, etc., and leverage AI agents to identify and neutralize digital threats. - Build real-time data pipelines to ingest data from millions of websites, social media accounts, and cryptocurrency tokens daily, using agile methodologies. - Build out software infrastructure required to rapidly scale the engineering organization and to ingest the data at scale in a robust, fault-tolerant manner. - Design and implement software engineering processes. - Build full-stack software product features. - Design, develop, and maintain software applications and systems. - Train and integrate AI models to identify and classify phishing and counterfeiting scams. - Perform software systems integrations. - Manage tasks end-to-end to ensure customer demands are met and software products are shipped on time. - Stood up a staging environment to ensure safer releases, feature validation, and automated integration testing before production rollouts. - Triage, troubleshoot, and debug performance issues and maintain reliability at scale. - Hybrid. May work from home. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related discipline. Experience: Depends on level/type. JOIN DOPPEL Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective. We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you.

southparkcommons-vori:ashbyhq:82c6d5a2-6.title: Growth Marketing Lead
southparkcommons-vori:ashbyhq:82c6d5a2-6.description: ABOUT VORI: Vori is transforming the future of the $1T grocery industry. Vori is a rapidly growing fintech + vertical AI startup that provides an integrated operating system  POS, payment processing, and inventory management.
